description:
Desktop application for DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent harness

DeepSeek Harness is the desktop application for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI. It bundles the dsh runtime in an Electron desktop shell and hosts the dsh Web UI locally, so agents can work with files, terminals, browsers, models, and plugins through an everything-is-a-plugin architecture.
New Features
- Add an experimental DeepSeek chat import plugin to import past conversations from DeepSeek App or its web version into a workspace and continue chatting. by @imccyu
Bug Fixes
- Fix an issue that could cause Windows desktop in-app updates to fail and prevent the app from reopening automatically. by @winewill
Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.3
source: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.
